第62章 怒怼赵支书-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“乃香，你没事吧？”李青山望着怀中娇软的王乃香，开口问道。

光天化日之下，大庭广众之间！

李青山一个单身汉，就这么大胆的搂着一个俏寡妇，要是在以前，早就被人吐沫星子给淹死了。

但是，刚刚什么情况，大家也不是没看到。

生死之间了。

谁还管得了这些？

再说了，李青山这小子，不也是为了救王乃香吗？

众人倒是不觉得有什么不对劲的。

“没，没事……！”

王乃香连忙从李青山怀中挣脱开，稍微抱着一会倒也无妨，大家就当受惊过度，但要是一直这样的话，就不正常了。

王乃香也懂得尺度。

在这个年代，一个寡妇肯定会非常容易传出绯闻的，而且唾沫星子和谣言蜚语真的能杀人。

要不是李青山这个人强势。

堵得大家不敢说闲话，王乃香的日子肯定也不会好过。

当然了。

最关键的是，李青山是单身汉。

两个人都是单身，这种事情就算是挑明了，别人也说不得什么坏坏，只能说王乃香吃的真好。

一个小寡妇，找了一个纯情单身汉。

李青山闻着空气中淡淡的奶香味，颇为享受，看向王乃香的眼神中，也满是火热。

刚刚王乃香倒在李青山怀中的时候，李青山才知晓，什么才是水做的女人，虽然王乃香很瘦，毕竟一天饿两顿，但就是感觉身子骨很软，很柔……！

就像她的性格一样。

“山哥，这狗东西怎么处理？”大壮死死抓着赵瞎子，开口问道。

山哥要是出了意外。

日后，自己就再也不能上山跟着跑了，奶奶的，这赵瞎子真是该死。

站在旁边的赵红旗，差点就要拎着菜刀冲上来，砍了赵瞎子这废物，自己家好不容易迎来一阵曙光，差点就让这赵瞎子给掐灭了，好在李青山没事。

“干什么，干什么？”

就在这时。

一道洪亮的声音在人群后响起，村民们见到来人后纷纷让开一条路来。

"Naixiang, are you okay?" Li Qingshan looked at the soft Wang Naixiang in his arms and asked.

In broad daylight, in public!

If Li Qingshan, a single man, so boldly hugged a pretty widow, he would have been drowned by others in the past.

However, it’s not like everyone didn’t see what happened just now.

Between life and death.

Who cares about this?

Besides, isn’t this guy Li Qingshan also trying to save Wang Naixiang?

No one felt anything was wrong.

"No, it's okay...!"

Wang Naixiang quickly broke away from Li Qingshan's arms. It didn't hurt to hold him for a while. Everyone just pretended to be too frightened, but it would be abnormal if it continued like this.

Wang Naixiang also knows how to measure.

In this day and age, it is very easy for a widow to get involved in scandals, and spitting and rumors can really kill people.

If it weren't for Li Qingshan, this person is so strong.

If everyone is blocked and no one dares to gossip, Wang Naixiang's life will definitely not be easy.

Of course.

The most important thing is that Li Qingshan is a bachelor.

Both of them are single. Even if they make this clear, others can't say it's bad. They can only say that Wang Naixiang eats really well.

A young widow found an innocent bachelor.

Li Qingshan enjoyed the faint scent of milk in the air, and his eyes when looking at Wang Naixiang were full of passion.

When Wang Naixiang fell into Li Qingshan's arms just now, Li Qingshan realized what a woman made of water was. Although Wang Naixiang was very thin and had eaten twice a day, her body bones felt very soft and soft...!

Just like her character.

"Brother Shan, what should I do with this piece of shit?" Da Zhuang grabbed Blind Zhao tightly and asked.

If Brother Shan had an accident.

From now on, I will never be able to run up the mountain again, grandma, this blind Zhao really deserves to die.

Zhao Hongqi, who was standing next to him, almost rushed up with a kitchen knife and chopped down the good-for-nothing Blind Zhao. His family finally had a burst of light, and he almost killed Blind Zhao. Fortunately, Li Qingshan was fine.

"What, what?"

Just then.

A loud voice sounded from behind the crowd, and the villagers made way for them after seeing the visitor.
